description: (min,+) product of non-negative integer matrices: a -> (n+1)^(M-a), integer Strassen, min = 2M - (index of the leading base-(n+1) digit). Entries have Theta(M log n) bits.

subject: threshold decomposition + integer Strassen per distinct value
description: (max,min) product: for each distinct value t, Boolean product of [X >= t] and [Y >= t] by integer Strassen; C[i][j] = largest t with a witness. Cost: (#distinct values) x Strassen.
notes: Pseudo-polynomial: the number of Strassen calls equals the number of distinct values (<= 21 here).
